title: Agentic-debugging probe record (one JSONL line per probe event)
description: Sibling of the rust-test-harness runtime-probe events contract: line-oriented JSONL that pattern-based gate tooling can ingest (fail/warn regex over lines), with hypothesis-scoped fields for evidence-driven debugging.

ts.description: Timestamp: RFC3339 string or monotonic milliseconds; be consistent within a session.

session.description: Debug session id, matching the ledger and code markers.

probe.description: Probe id matching the POLYDBG code marker (p1, p2, ...).

data.description: Observation payload; hash/checksum large state instead of embedding it.

level.description: Optional severity for harness-style warn/fail pattern gates.
